Name: Movement Overhaul
Author: Rafseazz
Description:

[b]-- Movement Overhaul --[/b][/center]
[center][b][color=#ffff00][size=3][url=https://emojipedia.org/sparkles]✨[/url] Jump!!! [url=https://emojipedia.org/sparkles]✨[/url][/size][/color][/b]
[color=#fff2cc](Default keybind: "Spacebar")
This feature introduces a dynamic and highly customizable jumping ability to traverse the world in a new way.[/color][/center]
[b][color=#ffe599]Dual Jumping Styles: [/color][/b]You can choose your preferred method of jumping in the settings.﻿
[list][*][color=#d9ead3][b]Instant Press:[/b] [/color]A classic, responsive jump that occurs the moment you press the jump key ("Spacebar" by default).
[*][b][color=#d9ead3]Hold & Release[/color][/b] (Default): Hold the jump key to charge your jump. The longer you hold, the higher & farther the arc of your jump will be, allowing for more skill expression in leaps.
[/list][b][color=#ffe599]Advanced Movement & Pathfinding: [/color][/b]Jumping is deeply integrated with player movement.[list][*]Momentum Distance: Your forward jump distance is directly affected by your movement speed. A running start will result in a much longer leap than a standing hop.
[*]Charge Distance: A configurable option (on by default) allows your charge level to also increase your jump distance, rewarding fully charged running jumps.
[*]Intelligent Pathfinding: The mod automatically scans the path in front of you to find the furthest possible safe landing spot, preventing you from jumping directly into a wall.
[/list][b][color=#ffe599]Environmental Interaction:[/color][/b][list][*]Jump Over Obstacles: You can leap over many common obstacles, including fences, bushes, saplings, craftable machines, and even NPCs. This mod also allows leaping over trashcans and mine ladders coz why not?
[*]Strict Collision: The logic is smart enough to prevent you from jumping through solid objects like full-grown trees, cliffs, or buildings.
[*]Configurable Obstacles: You can choose in the settings whether you want to be able to jump over large resource clumps like stumps, logs, and boulders.
[*]"Hop Over Anything" Mode: For fun or testing, you can enable a "cheat" mode that allows you to jump through any obstacle in the game.
[*]Map Maker Support: The mod will respect a custom tile property "Jumpable", allowing you to leap over any tile designated by a map creator.
[/list][b][color=#ffe599]Horse Jumping & Customization:[/color][/b][list][*]The entire jump system, including charging and pathfinding, works seamlessly while you're riding your horse.
[*]Horse jumps have a significantly higher and more powerful arc than on-foot jumps.
[*]The "Rider Bounce" is a configurable slider that controls how much your farmer moves in the saddle during a horse jump for a more realistic or stable look.
[*]You can customize the stamina cost of jumping, the sound effect, the jump's duration, and its base height.
[/list][center][color=#ffff00][size=3][b][url=https://emojipedia.org/sparkles]✨[/url] SPRINT!!! [url=https://emojipedia.org/sparkles]✨
[/url][/b][/size][/color][color=#fff2cc](Default keybind: Double-Tap movement key)
This feature adds a versatile and tactical sprinting system.
[/color][/center][b][color=#ffe599]Three Sprint Modes: [/color][/b]You can select from three distinct activation methods in the settings.[list][*][b][color=#d9ead3]Double-Tap (Default): [/color][/b]The classic method. Quickly tap a movement key or flick a controller stick (yes controller support) twice for a timed burst of speed.
[*][b][color=#d9ead3]Hold Key: [/color][/b]Sprint for as long as you hold down a dedicated, configurable Sprint Key ("Left Alt" by default).
[*][b][color=#d9ead3]Toggle Key:[/color][/b] Press the dedicated Sprint Key once to turn sprinting on, and press it again to turn it off.
[/list][b][color=#ffe599]Gameplay Mechanics:[/color][/b][list][*]Stamina Drain: Sprinting is powerful but comes at a cost, draining your stamina over time. The rate of stamina loss is fully configurable.
[*]Path Speed Bonus: You receive an additional speed boost when sprinting on crafted paths and roads, rewarding you for building infrastructure on your farm and around town.
[*]Horse Sprinting: You can sprint while on your horse for a massive speed increase. The horse's sprint speed is a separate, configurable multiplier, and a somewhat galloping sound plays for added immersion.
[*]Customization: You can enable or disable the entire sprint feature, change keybindings, and choose from a wide variety of particle effects.
[/list][center][b][color=#ffff00][size=3][url=https://emojipedia.org/sparkles]
✨[/url] New Combat Overhaul [url=https://emojipedia.org/sparkles]✨
[/url][/size][/color][/b][color=#fff2cc]Movement is now a weapon.
This mod adds two new configurable attack types that integrate directly with your new abilities.[/color][/center][b][color=#ffe599]Dash Attack:[/color][/b][list][*]Unleash a powerful lunging attack by using your weapon while sprinting (or within a brief "grace period" after).
[*]This attack costs stamina, propels you forward, and can hit multiple enemies in your path.
[*]Weapon-Specific Feel: The Area of Effect changes based on your weapon type: a wide, sweeping arc for Clubs, a precise strike for Daggers, and a standard lunge for Swords.
[*]Configurable Cooldowns: The dash has a fully configurable, weapon-specific cooldown, adding a new layer of combat strategy.
[*]Customizable Particles: The dash has its own particle effect, separate from sprinting. You can choose the effect, its volume, and whether it appears as a "centered burst" or a "lagging trail."
[/list][b][color=#ffe599]Jump Attack:[/color][/b][list][*]Execute a powerful aerial strike! Any melee attack performed while in the air during a jump will deal a configurable amount of bonus damage.
[/list][center][b][color=#ffff00][size=3][url=https://emojipedia.org/sparkles]
✨[/url] Whistling!!! [url=https://emojipedia.org/sparkles]✨
[/url][/size][/color][/b][color=#fff2cc](Default keybind: "," (Comma key))
This adds a new configurable key to interact with the world around you.[/color][/center][b][color=#ffe599]Call pet!: [/color][/b][list][*]Whistling will call your pet to your side. If you're on the farm, it will also call any farm animals that meet a configurable friendship level.
[/list][b][color=#ffe599]NPC Interaction:[/color][/b][list][*]Whistling near an NPC will make them pause for a brief period so you can catch up to them!
[*]Annoyance System: Be careful! Whistling repeatedly near the same NPC will annoy them, eventually resulting in a configurable friendship penalty.
[/list][b][color=#ffe599]Gameplay Functions:[/color][/b][list][*](Configurable) You can set the whistle to attract the attention and aggression of nearby monsters in dangerous areas.
[*](Configurable) You can choose to hear the whistles of other players in multiplayer, but only if they are in the same location as you.
[/list][center][b][color=#ffff00][size=3][url=https://emojipedia.org/sparkles]
✨[/url] Sit! :3 [url=https://emojipedia.org/sparkles]✨
[/url][/size][/color][/b][color=#fff2cc](Default keybind: "." (Period key))
This feature adds regeneration while sitting and the ability to sit on the ground.[/color][/center][b][color=#ffe599]Sit on the ground![/color][/b][list][*]Press the Sit Key ("." by default) to sit on the ground!
[*]Spammable for some funny emoting.
[/list][b][color=#ffe599]Stamina Regeneration:[/color][/b][list][*]After a short delay, you will begin to regenerate stamina.
[*]The regeneration rate is different for sitting on the ground versus sitting in a chair, and both rates are configurable.
[/list]  [b][color=#ffe599]Immersive Buffs & Interactions: [/color][/b]All of these are optional and can be toggled in the settings.[list][*]Social Sitting: Sitting near an NPC or your pet for 15 seconds will grant a small friendship boost and display a friendly pop-up message.
[*]Warming Up: Sitting near a lit fireplace or campfire for 5 seconds grants a temporary "Warmed" buff, giving you +20 Max Stamina and +1 Speed.
[*]Meditate for a Buff: (Off by default) Sitting still in the same pose for an extended period grants a "Focused" buff, giving you +1 Luck.
[*]Idle Effects: After sitting still for a while, your farmer will occasionally perform random emotes.
[/list][center][b][color=#ffff00][size=3][url=https://emojipedia.org/sparkles]
✨[/url] Passive Regeneration (Configurable) [url=https://emojipedia.org/sparkles]✨
[/url][/size][/color][/b][color=#fff2cc]This feature adds passive stamina regeneration for non-strenuous activity.
[/color][/center][list][*][b][color=#ffe599]Stand & Walk Regen:[/color][/b] Automatically regenerate a small, configurable amount of stamina after a short, configurable delay when standing still or walking (but not running or sprinting).
[*][b][color=#ffe599]Customization:[/color][/b] You can enable/disable standing and walking regen independently and set their unique regen rates.
[/list][center][b][color=#ffff00][size=3][url=https://emojipedia.org/sparkles]
✨[/url] More "Movement" Related Visual & Immersion Overhaul [url=https://emojipedia.org/sparkles]✨
[/url][/size][/color][/b][color=#fff2cc]A collection of configurable features to make the game look and feel more fluid and alive.
[/color][/center][list][*][b][color=#ffe599]Adaptive Animation Speed:[/color][/b] Your character's running/walking animation speed will now dynamically match your actual movement speed, making speed buffs and sprinting look natural.
[*][b][color=#ffe599]Smoother Turning (Off by default): [/color][/b]A REALLY subtle transitional animation is added when quickly changing from facing left to right (or vice-versa). (Why not?)
[*][b][color=#ffe599]"Running Late" NPCs: [/color][/b](Configurable) Villagers who get stuck or fall far behind their daily schedule will intelligently speed up and run to their destinations.
[/list][center][b][color=#00ff00][size=3][url=https://emojipedia.org/sparkles]
✨[/url] General Mod Features [url=https://emojipedia.org/sparkles]✨
[/url][/size][/color][/b][/center][list][*][b][color=#ffe599]Full In-Game Configuration:[/color][/b] Every feature is customizable through an extensive menu provided by Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM).
[*][b][color=#ffe599]Live Config Updates:[/color][/b] All settings can be changed on the fly (when in the menu screen) and take effect instantly without needing to restart the game. (supposedly :3)
[*][b][color=#ffe599]Multiplayer Ready:[/color][/b] All visual effects (jumps, sprints, sitting, dashing, whistling) are synced in online multiplayer so others can see your actions.
[*][b][color=#ffe599]NPC Exclusion Lists: [/color][/b]Two separate, comma-separated exclusion lists in the config allow you to prevent specific NPCs (like Krobus, Dwarf, etc.) from being affected by the "Whistling" and "Running Late" mechanics.
[*][b][color=#ffe599]Translation Ready: [/color][/b]All text in the settings menu and in-game messages is translatable using i18n.
[*][b][color=#ffe599]Expansion-Compatible:  [/color]Such[/b] as RSV, LASV, ES, & SVE!
[*][b][color=#93c47d]Probable High Compatibility with other mods! (If you tweak the config well!):[/color] [/b][color=#f9cb9c] [/color][color=#f9cb9c]Just disable certain features that you think might overlap with other mods![/color]
[/list][color=#f9cb9c]

[/color][left][b][color=#ff7700][size=3][url=https://emojipedia.org/sparkles]✨[/url] Issues and Incompatibilities [url=https://emojipedia.org/sparkles]✨[/url][/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Incompatible with Mobile and Split-screen play unfortunately :c
[*]Jump doesn't have momentum when done in building tiles with the property "Passable" (like bridges). Still trying to figure this out.
[*]Make sure config NPC exclusion lists are the same when playing in multiplayer or else some bugs might show relating to the specific feature affected
[*]IDK about other mods yet. Please inform me if you find incompatibilities! Thanks!
[/list][/left]
